title: Mawson Infrastructure Group Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-23
summary: Mawson Infrastructure Group Inc. received a Nasdaq delist determination on April 17, 2026, due to failure to meet Listing Rule 5550(b) stockholders' equity requirements as of December 31, 2025; the company has requested a hearing before the Nasdaq Hearings Panel to present a compliance plan. The company also filed a name change from 'Mawson Infrastructure Group Inc.' to 'Big Digital Energy, Inc.' effective April 24, 2026, with a corresponding ticker change from MIGI to BGDE on April 30, 2026.
key_points: Received Nasdaq delist determination on April 17, 2026, for failure to maintain $2.5M stockholders' equity (Listing Rule 5550(b))
Company was under Mandatory Panel Monitor through December 22, 2026, following prior compliance determination
Company plans to request hearing before Nasdaq Hearings Panel to stay any delisting action
Company name change to 'Big Digital Energy, Inc.' filed April 20, 2026, effective April 24, 2026
Ticker symbol will change from MIGI to BGDE at market open on April 30, 2026
Company states it believes current stockholders' equity exceeds the $2.5M threshold
